scripts.build:tauri: npm run setup:kubo && node scripts/prepare-kubo-for-build.js && vite build && tauri build
scripts.build:tauri:release:all: npm run setup:kubo:all && node scripts/prepare-kubo-for-build.js && vite build && tauri build --bundles nsis,msi
scripts.build:tauri:windows: npm run setup:kubo -- --platform win32 && node scripts/prepare-kubo-for-build.js && vite build && tauri build --bundles nsis,msi
scripts.build:tauri:macos: npm run setup:kubo -- --platform darwin && node scripts/prepare-kubo-for-build.js && vite build && tauri build --bundles dmg
scripts.build:tauri:linux: npm run setup:kubo -- --platform linux && node scripts/prepare-kubo-for-build.js && vite build && tauri build --bundles appimage
scripts.setup:kubo:all: node scripts/setup-kubo.js --platform win32 && node scripts/setup-kubo.js --platform darwin && node scripts/setup-kubo.js --platform linux
